reliability;
the Commission is not satisfied as to the financial
standing of the applicant or the manner in which the
applicant’s business is to be conducted;

past  performance  or  expertise  of  the  applicant,
having regard to the nature of the business which
the applicant may carry on in connection with the
holding of the licence and there exists circumstances
which are likely to -

(i)

executive officer or controller; or

reflect discredit on the manner of conducting
the business of the applicant;
